# nlohmann/json

Vendored single-header release v3.12.0 (MIT license).

- Header: `include/nlohmann/json.hpp`
- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.12.0/json.hpp
- SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`

The GameFramework and Game Premake projects expose the `include` directory, so
source files can use `#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>`. The library is header-only
and needs no link library.
